intro.text:
* Oh dear, that took
  longer than I
  thought it would.

greeting.text:
* How did you get
  here, my child?
* Are you hurt?

full.text:
* Not a scratch...
* Impressive!
* But still...

hurt.text:
* There, there, I will
  heal you.

critical.text:
* Who did this to you? 
* You will get an apology.

follow.text:
* I should not have
  left you alone
  for so long.

* It was irresponsible
  to try to surprise
  you like this.

* Well, I suppose I
  cannot hide it
  any longer.

tree:
* Every time this old tree
  grows any leaves, they fall
  right off.
treeEnd:
* (It's natural for a tree to
  lose its leaves.)
save:
* (Seeing such a cute, tidy
  house in the RUINS gives
  you determination.)
